key_fact: Starfish can regrow their entire bodies from a single severed arm, provided part of the central disc remains attached.
hook: Starfish can clone themselves from just one arm.
title: Starfish Regrow From One Arm
script: Starfish can clone themselves from just one arm. If a predator bites one off, it isn't just a lost limb. Most animals just heal a wound, but these creatures use specialized cells to rebuild from scratch. As long as a tiny piece of the central disc stays attached, that single arm grows a brand new mouth and four more limbs. It is the ultimate survival hack. Would you keep a spare arm around if it meant you could start over?

verification.problems: The script implies all starfish can regenerate from a single arm, but this is highly dependent on the species and the presence of central disc tissue.

claims.claim: Starfish can clone themselves from just one arm.
claims.note: Only possible if a portion of the central disc is attached; regeneration from an arm alone without disc tissue is rare or impossible in most species.

claims.claim: If a predator bites one off, it isn't just a lost limb.
claims.note: Autotomy is a common defense mechanism in sea stars.

claims.claim: These creatures use specialized cells to rebuild from scratch.
claims.note: Regeneration involves dedifferentiation and blastema formation.

claims.claim: As long as a tiny piece of the central disc stays attached, that single arm grows a brand new mouth and four more limbs.
